title: Mengajukan kerja sama publik dengan data lengkap
description: Mitra publik dapat mengirim pengajuan kerja sama dengan seluruh data wajib dan melihat konfirmasi pengiriman.

steps.description: Navigate to /pengajuan-kerjasama
Fill in the partner identity fields with valid information
Select a valid bidang kerja sama
Select a valid ruang lingkup
Upload a valid proposal PDF
Submit the application
Verify a submission confirmation is visible

title: Public user can submit a partnership application
description: This verifies that a public applicant can complete the cooperation request form, upload a proposal PDF, and see the submission confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /pengajuan-kerjasama
Fill in the applicant name field with PT Mitra Publik
Fill in the institution email field with publik@example.com
Fill in the contact phone field with 081234567891
Fill in the cooperation subject field with Kerja Sama Pelatihan
Fill in the description field with Permohonan kerja sama pelatihan bersama kampus
Upload a valid proposal PDF
Submit the partnership application
Verify a submission confirmation is visible

title: Masuk ke dashboard sesuai peran
description: Pengguna berhasil masuk dan diarahkan ke dashboard sesuai role yang dimilikinya.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the appropriate role dashboard

title: Admin can sign in and reach the dashboard
description: This verifies that an admin can log in successfully and land on the admin dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Memvalidasi pengajuan mitra dan menyetujui permohonan
description: Pimpinan dapat meninjau pengajuan mitra dan menyetujui permohonan sehingga status pengajuan berubah.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Open the partner submission review page
Open a pending submission
Approve the submission
Verify the submission status is updated

title: Leader can approve a partner submission
description: This verifies that a leader can open an incoming submission, approve it, and see the status update.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /pimpinan/pengajuan-mitra
Open an incoming submission
Approve the submission
Verify the submission status is updated to approved

title: Mengirim draft dokumen ke pimpinan untuk evaluasi
description: Unit internal dapat mengirim draft dokumen kerja sama ke pimpinan dan melihat status berubah menjadi menunggu evaluasi.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with jurusan@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Open the cooperation documents page
Select an existing draft document
Submit the document to the leader for validation
Verify the document status changes to waiting for evaluation

title: Keluar dari sesi akun
description: Pengguna yang sudah masuk dapat keluar dan kembali ke halaman login.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Click the logout control
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Menyimpan dokumen kerja sama baru sebagai draft
description: Unit internal dapat membuat dokumen kerja sama baru dan menyimpannya sebagai draft yang muncul di daftar dokumen.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with jurusan@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Open the cooperation documents page
Start creating a new cooperation document
Fill in the document details with valid information
Upload a valid scanned PDF
Save the document as a draft
Verify the new draft appears in the document list

title: Leader can request revision with notes
description: This verifies that a leader can request changes on a submission and the revision status appears with notes saved.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /pimpinan/pengajuan-mitra
Open an incoming submission
Request revision for the submission
Fill in the revision notes field with Mohon lengkapi dokumen pendukung
Submit the revision request
Verify the submission status is updated to revision requested

title: Meminta revisi pengajuan mitra dengan catatan
description: Pimpinan dapat meminta revisi pada pengajuan mitra dan catatan revisi tersimpan sebagai hasil keputusan.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Open the partner submission review page
Open a pending submission
Request revision with a note
Verify the revision request is recorded

title: Admin can send login access to a partner without an account
description: This verifies that an admin can filter partners without an account and trigger the login access action successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/mitra
Filter partners to show those without an account
Click the send login access action for one partner
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the partner is marked as having access sent

title: Admin can add a new user
description: This verifies that an admin can create a new user from the user management page and see it appear in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/users
Click the add user action
Fill in the name field with Test User Admin
Fill in the identification number field with 1234567890123456
Fill in the email field with testuseradmin@example.com
Fill in the password field with Password123!
Select an appropriate role
Save the user
Verify the new user appears in the user list

title: Leader can reject a submission with a reason
description: This verifies that a leader can reject a submission with a reason and see the rejected status reflected in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /pimpinan/pengajuan-mitra
Open an incoming submission
Reject the submission
Fill in the rejection reason field with Pengajuan belum memenuhi persyaratan
Submit the rejection
Verify the submission status is updated to rejected

title: Menolak kredensial yang salah
description: Pengguna melihat pesan kesalahan ketika mencoba masuk dengan kredensial yang tidak valid.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with invalid-user@example.com
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the login form
Verify an invalid credentials alert is visible

title: Admin can register a new partner
description: This verifies that an admin can add a mitra record and see the partner registered in the mitra list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/mitra
Click the add partner action
Fill in the institution name field with PT Mitra Contoh
Fill in the address field with Jalan Contoh 1
Fill in the email field with mitra.contoh@example.com
Fill in the phone field with 081234567890
Select a classification
Save the partner
Verify the new partner appears in the mitra list

title: Mengedit draft dokumen kerja sama dan melihat perubahan tersimpan
description: Unit internal dapat membuka draft dokumen kerja sama, memperbarui isinya, lalu melihat perubahan pada detail dokumen.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with jurusan@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Open the cooperation documents page
Select an existing draft document
Edit the document details
Save the changes
Verify the updated document details are displayed

title: Admin can create a new role
description: This verifies that an admin can add a role with permissions and see the role saved in the roles list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/roles
Click the add role action
Fill in the role name field with Reviewer Khusus
Select the required permissions
Save the role
Verify the new role appears in the roles list

title: Menampilkan validasi saat pengajuan publik belum lengkap
description: Form pengajuan kerja sama publik menolak pengiriman ketika data wajib belum diisi.

steps.description: Navigate to /pengajuan-kerjasama
Fill in the partner identity fields with partial valid information
Select a valid bidang kerja sama
Submit the application
Verify a form validation error is visible

title: Admin can add a new cooperation type
description: This verifies that an admin can create a new jenis kerja sama entry and see it listed afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/jkerjasama
Click the add cooperation type action
Fill in the name field with Kerja Sama Riset
Fill in the code field with RSK
Fill in the description field with Jenis kerja sama untuk riset kolaboratif
Save the cooperation type
Verify the new cooperation type appears in the list

title: Mitra melihat dokumen dan memberikan review pada draft
description: Mitra yang sudah login dapat membuka daftar dokumen kerja sama, meninjau draft yang tersedia, dan mengirim feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Open the partner documents page
Open an available draft document
Submit a review or feedback
Verify the review is saved and visible

title: Mitra can view documents and review a draft
description: This verifies that a logged-in partner can open the document page, inspect a draft cooperation document, and submit feedback on it.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with admin@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Navigate to /mitra/dokumen
Open a draft document
Enter review feedback for the draft
Submit the review feedback
Verify the draft review is saved and visible

title: Mencegah pengeditan dokumen yang sudah bukan draft
description: Unit internal tidak dapat mengubah dokumen kerja sama yang sudah berstatus selain draft.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the NIK or email field with jurusan@polnado.ac.id
Fill in the password field with password
Submit the login form
Open the cooperation documents page
Select a document with a non-draft status
Verify the document cannot be edited
